# Tripmetic

> Tripmetic is a free travel app for iOS and Android. It helps travelers plan and manage trips with multi-currency budgets, a smart currency converter (live + offline rates), dual clock widgets, an interactive bucket map, packing lists, offline maps, document vault, and group trip planning—in one download.

Tripmetic is a DBA of DTLA Professional Services, LLC (Los Angeles, CA). Website: https://tripmetic.app

Download:
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tripmetic/id6765632920
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tripmetic.app

## Feature pages (travel tools)

- [Smart Currency Converter](https://tripmetic.app/smart-currency-converter): Live and offline currency conversion for travel
- [Currency Calculator](https://tripmetic.app/currency-calculator): Public travel calculator using Tripmetic's live and cached exchange rates
- [Dual Clock Widget](https://tripmetic.app/clock-widget): Home vs destination timezone widget
- [Bucket Map / Travel Bucket List](https://tripmetic.app/bucket-list-app): Interactive map of been / lived / want destinations
- [Multi-Country Budget](https://tripmetic.app/multi-country-budget): Track expenses across countries with live FX
- [Global Meeting Scheduler](https://tripmetic.app/global-meeting-scheduler): Find overlapping business hours across timezones
- [Document Vault](https://tripmetic.app/document-vault): Offline storage for passports, visas, and flights
- [Bill Splitter & Smart Gratuity](https://tripmetic.app/bill-splitter-smart-gratuity): Culture-aware tipping and bill splitting
- [Cryptocurrency Converter](https://tripmetic.app/cryptocurrency-converter): Crypto to fiat conversion for travel
- [Brainstorming Mind Map](https://tripmetic.app/brainstorming-mind-map): Visual trip planning canvas
- [Group Trip Planner](https://tripmetic.app/group-trip-planner): Collaborative itineraries and shared budgets
- [International Size Converter](https://tripmetic.app/international-size-converter): Clothing and shoe sizes across regions
- [Packing List](https://tripmetic.app/packing-list): Offline zen packing checklists
- [Unit Converter](https://tripmetic.app/unit-converter): Metric and imperial conversions
- [Offline Map Guide](https://tripmetic.app/offline-map-guide): Download regions and navigate offline
